elements.label: EXAMPLE 3.20
elements.title: Example 3.20: Probability calculations for knee surgeries

nodes: Probability of success for one knee surgery = 0.89
connections: Probability of success for one knee surgery leads to Probability all four surgeries successful by multiplying four times
Probability of success for one knee surgery leads to Probability of unsuccessful surgery by complement rule
Probability of unsuccessful surgery leads to Probability all four surgeries unsuccessful by multiplying four times

elements.summary: This example illustrates how to calculate the probability that all four knee surgeries are successful, all unsuccessful, and at least one successful using the complement rule and independence assumption.
